svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Cut 686 mm of 25 x 25 x 2 mm tube; cap the ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 8.5 mm vertically through both walls:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ring bolt 13 mm from the inner end;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bracket bolt 65 mm from the outer end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the outer 45 mm rests on the top of the upright, flush with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its outer face; the bracket under it on the upright's inner face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The holder ring sits on the inner ends of both arms.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: laid across both uprights, the arms are level within 1 mm.
